summary.text: Amy Minich is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent Josh Hurlbert.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as laborer, and in a Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a working mother and union member.

paragraphs.text: Amy Minich advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for District 8 as the only candidate on the ballot.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her campaign is focused on protecting workers, strengthening public education, supporting healthcare access for all, and making Missouri a place where families can afford to live and work.
